verdict.rationale: Daily documents server-side room creation and token management, an official client SDK (daily-js / Daily React), and per-token properties set via the create-meeting-token REST endpoint. Together these cover the core pieces of the flow, but the evidence never shows them tied into one short end-to-end quickstart, and the token's scope (room or permission restrictions) is only implied. Missing for 10: a documented end-to-end server-to-client quickstart, explicit evidence of room- or permission-scoped token fields, and independent hands-on corroboration of how short the flow is.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create a session from my server, mint a scoped join token, and connect a client with the official SDK in a short documented flow

citations.quote: Create rooms, manage tokens, trigger recordings, and control calls from your server.
Full control over your call UI with daily-js, or use Daily React for a hooks-based React experience.

To start recording automatically when a token holder joins, use the [`start_cloud_recording`](https://docs.daily.co/reference/rest-api/meeting-tokens/create-meeting-token#body-properties-start-cloud-recording) token property.
Drop in a complete, customizable video call UI with a single line of code.
